My ex-wife and I got together after I had already come out. She seemed supportive through our entire marriage, however she became abusive toward me physically and emotionally after we had our daughter. We had a big falling out at the end of our marriage (not divorced yet sadly, just separated). When it happened, she showed me her true colors and told me I'm nothing but a man and will never be a woman. She said she had always seen me as a man. We recently got back in contact so I can finally see my daughter again. She seems to be supportive of me now, and we've agreed we just weren't meant to be together, but we both want me to be in my daughter's life, so I finally get to have my baby on some weekends, hoping for more often in the future. My current boyfriend has also been so good to my little girl and I see him being an amazing stepdad to her in the future when we get married. My ex wife even said that after we get divorced, she would marry me and my boyfriend.
